Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side after the discovery call:

What we heard:
- Primary constraint: you need customer-managed keys and HSM-backed KMS for encryption of model artifacts and logs.
- Identity: SSO via SAML/Okta is required for all users; we should integrate with your IdP.
- Logging & retention: legal asks for logs to be retained for 7 years (audit / regulatory).
- Network / data control: preference for Private VPC or on-prem for regulated workloads, but open to Dedicated if it satisfies KMS/HSM and logging retention.

Initial recommendation: Based on the constraints above, Private VPC (customer-managed networking) is the most straightforward way to meet HSM and long-term logging commitments. Dedicated capacity could be an option if we can support customer-managed KMS and extend log retention to 7 years (we'll need to validate storage/retention policy and audit trail coverage). Hosted API will not meet the KMS/HSM requirement or long-term logging SLA.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Dev (cc'd) to confirm technical feasibility for KMS/HSM & long-term log export options and share a short matrix by EOD tomorrow.
2) Schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive with your infra/security team (please share a couple of times).
3) I'll circulate a checklist (SSO + KMS integration items) and a draft timeline + pricing delta between Dedicated vs Private.

Attachments: SSO-integration-checklist.pdf (first pass)

If that aligns, I can set up the tech call and pull in our infra lead.

Thanks —

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side to make the technical scope explicit:

1) SSO/Identity:
- Must support SAML 2.0 integration with Okta as IdP.
- SCIM provisioning preferred but not mandatory in phase 1.

2) KMS/HSM:
- We require customer-managed keys with a HSM-backed KMS (AWS CloudHSM or Azure Dedicated HSM).
- Key rotation policy enforced by us; Redwood must accept CMK references or offer BYOK (bring your own key).

3) Logging & retention:
- Logs related to inference requests, audit trails (who accessed/created keys), and admin actions need to be retained for 7 years in an immutable store.
- Ability to export to our archival S3 (or equivalent) with compliance controls.

4) Network:
- Private VPC peering or on-prem option required. No public-hosted endpoints for regulated workloads.

If Dedicated can support HSM-backed BYOK + long-term log export to our archive plus SAML integration, we're open to it. If not, we'll need Private deployment.

We can do a technical deep-dive tomorrow 10:30–11:15 PT if that works for your team.

Appreciate it —
Alex

Thanks Alex — good notes. Quick technical read from our infra side and what we'll validate on the deep-dive:

- SAML / SCIM: Redwood's control plane supports SAML 2.0 for SSO. SCIM provisioning is supported on Dedicated and Private; for Hosted we can do SAML SSO but provisioning will be manual or via custom scripts.

- KMS/HSM:
  * Hosted API: only Redwood-managed keys — does not meet CMK/HSM requirement.
  * Dedicated: we support BYOK via customer-managed KMS in many deployments; HSM-backed KMS (e.g., CloudHSM) is possible with Dedicated if the customer provisions the HSM and we configure the key references — this requires network connectivity and limited admin play.
  * Private (VPC/on-prem): native integration with customer KMS/HSM and full control over key material — highest compatibility.

- Logging & retention:
  * Hosted API: limited retention controls; cannot guarantee 7-year immutable retention for regulated workloads.
  * Dedicated: we can stream logs to customer-owned archival S3 and configure retention policies; need to validate immutability (object lock) with your security team. Additional storage costs apply.
  * Private: full support for exporting logs to your archive and meeting immutability/compliance controls.

Attachments: deployment_matrix.xlsx (matrix comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private across requirements), kms_hsm_integration_notes.pdf (integration checklist for HSM/BYOK).

Conclusion (short): if FinTechCo requires HSM-backed KMS + 7-year immutable retention + no public endpoints, Private deployment is the safer path. Dedicated is feasible if FinTechCo is willing to provision customer HSMs and accept network peering plus added contract terms around logging retention and proof of immutability.

I can be on the call tomorrow at 10:30 PT to go through the integration steps.

- Dev
